meta.name: NIPUN Bharat FLN learning outcomes (representative subset)
meta.note: Reworded, grade-appropriate outcomes aligned to the NIPUN Bharat foundational literacy & numeracy framework for this proof of concept. A representative subset assembled for the demo, not an official copy of the Lakshya documents.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Literacy
outcomes.text: Student identifies and names common animals, objects and people in the surroundings.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Literacy
outcomes.text: Student recognizes letters and reads simple two-letter and three-letter words aloud.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Literacy
outcomes.text: Student listens to a short story and answers simple questions about it.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Numeracy
outcomes.text: Student counts orally from 1 to 10 using concrete objects.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Numeracy
outcomes.text: Student compares groups of objects using more, less and equal.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Literacy
outcomes.text: Student reads short sentences aloud with understanding and matches them to pictures.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Literacy
outcomes.text: Student identifies and names common animals and describes them in one line.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Literacy
outcomes.text: Student writes two to three simple words from dictation.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Numeracy
outcomes.text: Student reads and writes numbers up to 50.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Numeracy
outcomes.text: Student adds and subtracts single-digit numbers using objects.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Literacy
outcomes.text: Student reads a grade-level paragraph fluently and answers who/what/where questions.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Literacy
outcomes.text: Student writes two to three connected sentences about a familiar topic.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Numeracy
outcomes.text: Student solves simple daily-life word problems involving addition.

outcomes.subject: Foundational Numeracy
outcomes.text: Student identifies simple shapes in the surroundings and counts their sides.
